original_title: Obsession Breakout Star Inde Navarrette Goes Viral for Old Streams of the Last of Us, PlayStation Responds
summary_en: Actress Inde Navarrette, who recently captivated audiences in the hit horror film 'Obsession,' is now making waves online for her rediscovered gaming past. Clips of her playing 'The Last of Us' have exploded in popularity, even catching the eye of PlayStation itself.
ai_analysis: This story highlights the fascinating intersection of film and gaming fame, showing how a star's personal passion for interactive entertainment can generate significant buzz and engagement within the gaming community.

en.title: Obsession Star Inde Navarrette's Viral Gaming Streams Spark PlayStation Response
en.summary: Actress Inde Navarrette, who recently captivated audiences in the hit horror film 'Obsession,' is now making waves online for her rediscovered gaming past. Clips of her playing 'The Last of Us' have exploded in popularity, even catching the eye of PlayStation itself.
en.body:
The breakout success of the indie horror film **Obsession**, a surprising box office darling made for a modest $750,000 and grossing over $200 million, has catapulted its stars into the spotlight. Among them is **Inde Navarrette**, whose performance as a young woman grappling with an unsettling obsession has earned widespread acclaim. However, it's not just her acting prowess that has captured public attention; fans have unearthed a treasure trove of her past gaming livestreams, igniting a viral sensation.

These rediscovered streams, featuring Navarrette diving into beloved titles like **The Last of Us** and **Outlast**, have circulated rapidly across social media platforms. One particular partial playthrough of **The Last of Us** garnered an astonishing 650,000 views in just three days on a YouTube channel that appears to be dedicated to her older content. This surge in interest has not gone unnoticed by the gaming industry itself. PlayStation UK humorously responded via their X account, stating, "We're obsessed," directly referencing the film's title and acknowledging Navarrette's renewed connection with gaming.

## A Gamer's Journey Resurfaces

Navarrette herself has spoken about her lifelong connection to video games. In a recent interview with GQ, she shared how gaming was a significant part of her childhood, often played with her older brother Amani. She explained that streaming became a natural extension of this passion during her downtime, describing it as "just something that I really love to do." The discovery of her streams has led to a strong fan outcry, with many expressing a desire for her to return to live streaming on platforms like Twitch. Her impressive gameplay and genuine enthusiasm have resonated deeply with a community eager to see her reconnect with her gaming roots.

## Fan Frenzy and a Potential Return

The internet's reaction has been overwhelmingly positive, with fans celebrating Navarrette's dual talents as both a compelling actress and a passionate gamer. Social media platforms are abuzz with clips and discussions, fueling calls for her comeback to the streaming world. This viral moment underscores the powerful bond between creators and their audiences, especially when shared passions like gaming come into play. The demand for her to return to streaming is a testament to the authentic connection she forged with viewers through her gameplay.

## What's Next

While Navarrette has returned to streaming and playing games like **The Last of Us** and **Outlast**, details regarding any official return to regular streaming schedules or new content plans have not yet been announced. Fans are eagerly awaiting any further updates from the star, hopeful that this viral resurgence will translate into a sustained presence in the gaming community.

tr.title: Obsesyon Starı Inde Navarrette'in Viral Oyun Akışları PlayStation'dan Yanıt Aldı
tr.summary: Obsesyon filmi ile dikkatleri üzerine çeken Inde Navarrette, eski oyun akışlarının keşfedilmesi ile birlikte internet fenomeni haline geldi. The Last of Us oynarken çekilen videoları milyonlarca kişi tarafından izlendi ve PlayStation tarafından da dikkat çekti.
tr.body:
## Obsesyon Starı Inde Navarrette'in Oyun Akışları
Obsesyon filmi, düşük bir bütçeyle yapılmış olmasına rağmen büyük bir başarı elde etti ve oyuncularını da ön plana çıkardı. Bunlardan biri de Inde Navarrette, filmdeki performansı ile geniş bir kitle tarafından tanınmaya başladı. Ancak sadece oyunculuk yeteneği ile değil, aynı zamanda eski oyun akışlarının keşfedilmesi ile de gündeme geldi.

Bu akışlar, The Last of Us ve Outlast gibi sevilen oyunları içeriyor ve sosyal medya platformlarında hızla yayıldı. The Last of Us'un bir kısmının oynandığı bir video, sadece üç günde 650.000 kez izlendi. Bu ilgi, oyun endüstrisi tarafından da fark edildi. PlayStation UK, X hesabından "Obsesyondayız" diyerek filmdeki rolüne ve oyunlara geri dönüşüne atıfta bulundu.

## Bir Oyuncunun Yolculuğu
Navarrette, çocukluğunda oyun oynamaya başladığını ve bu hobisini kardeşleri ile paylaştığını söyledi. Daha sonra bu tutkusu, boş zamanlarında akış yapmaya dönüşmüştü. İnternetteki keşfi, hayranların onun geri dönmesi için çağrıda bulunmasına neden oldu. Oyuncular, Navarrette'in geri dönmesini ve oyun akışlarına devam etmesini istiyor.

## Hayran Çılgınlığı ve Mümkün Bir Dönüş
İnternetin tepkisi çok olumlu oldu ve hayranlar Navarrette'in hem iyi bir oyuncusu hem de tutkulu bir oyun severi olduğunu kutladı. Sosyal medya platformlarında videolar ve tartışmalar yayıldı ve onun geri dönmesi için çağrıda bulunuldu. Bu viral an, yaratıcılar ve izleyicileri arasındaki güçlü bağı gösteriyor. Hayranların geri dönmesi için çağrıda bulunması, onun oyun severlerle kurduğu samimi bağın bir kanıtı.

## Sonraki Adımlar
Navarrette, The Last of Us ve Outlast gibi oyunları oynamaya geri dönmüş olsa da, düzenli akış takvimleri veya yeni içerik planları hakkında henüz bir açıklama yapılmadı. Hayranlar, bu viral anın onun oyun topluluğunda sürekliliğine dönüşmesini umuyor.

es.title: La estrella de Obsesión, Inde Navarrette, revive su pasión por los videojuegos y cautiva a PlayStation
es.summary: La actriz Inde Navarrette, que recientemente cautivó a los espectadores en la película de terror 'Obsesión', ahora está haciendo oleada en línea por su pasado en los videojuegos. Los clips de ella jugando 'The Last of Us' han explotado en popularidad, incluso capturando la atención de PlayStation.
es.body:
El éxito inesperado de la película de terror independiente **Obsesión**, una sorprendente estrella de la taquilla hecha con un presupuesto modesto de $750,000 y recaudando más de $200 millones, ha catapultado a sus actores a la fama. Entre ellos se encuentra **Inde Navarrette**, cuya interpretación como una joven mujer que lucha con una obsesión perturbadora ha ganado aclamación general. Sin embargo, no es solo su talento actoral lo que ha capturado la atención pública; los fans han descubierto un tesoro de sus antiguos streams de juegos en vivo, desencadenando una sensación viral.

Estos streams redescubiertos, que presentan a Navarrette sumergida en títulos queridos como **The Last of Us** y **Outlast**, han circulado rápidamente a través de las plataformas de redes sociales. Un particular playthrough parcial de **The Last of Us** acumuló una impresionante 650.000 visualizaciones en solo tres días en un canal de YouTube que parece estar dedicado a su contenido más antiguo. Este aumento de interés no ha pasado desapercibido por la industria del gaming en sí. PlayStation UK respondió con humor a través de su cuenta X, afirmando: "Estamos obsesionados", haciendo referencia directa al título de la película y reconociendo la conexión renovada de Navarrette con los videojuegos.

## Un viaje de un gamer resurge

Navarrette misma ha hablado sobre su conexión a videojuegos a lo largo de su vida. En una reciente entrevista con GQ, compartió cómo el gaming fue una parte significativa de su infancia, a menudo jugado con su hermano mayor Amani. Explicó que la transmisión se convirtió en una extensión natural de esta pasión durante su tiempo libre, describiéndolo como "algo que realmente me encanta hacer". La descubierta de sus streams ha llevado a un fuerte clamor de los fans, muchos de los cuales expresan su deseo de que regrese a transmitir en plataformas como Twitch. Su impresionante juego y auténtica entusiasmo han resonado profundamente con una comunidad ansiosa por verla reconectar con sus raíces en el gaming.

## Frenesí de los fans y un posible regreso

La reacción de Internet ha sido abrumadoramente positiva, con los fans celebrando la doble habilidad de Navarrette como actriz convincente y gamer apasionada. Las plataformas de redes sociales están bullentes con clips y discusiones, impulsando las llamadas a su regreso a la transmisión. Este momento viral destaca el poderoso vínculo entre los creadores y sus audiencias, especialmente cuando se trata de pasiones compartidas como el gaming. La demanda de que regrese a transmitir es un testimonio de la conexión auténtica que forjó con los espectadores a través de su juego.

## Próximos pasos

Si bien Navarrette ha regresado a transmitir y jugar juegos como **The Last of Us** y **Outlast**, los detalles sobre cualquier regreso oficial a horarios de transmisión regulares o planes de contenido nuevos aún no han sido anunciados. Los fans están ansiosos por cualquier actualización adicional de la estrella, esperando que este renacer viral se traduzca en una presencia sostenida en la comunidad de gaming.

content_raw: Obsession breakout star, Inde Navarrette, is going viral for her gaming livestreams, including Sony hit The Last of Us. Last month, a brand new horror movie known as Obsession was released, and it has been one of Hollywood's biggest success stories. The film was made for just $750,000 before being picked up by Focus Features for distribution. It has since gone on to make over $200 million at the box office , making it one of the most profitable movies ever made. The film also catapulted the careers of first-time director Curry Barker and star Inde Navarrette. The actress plays a young woman who becomes erratic after her friend wishes for her to fall in love with him. Navarrette charmed audiences with her wicked performance, but has also been building an audience outside of film. Fans quickly discovered that the actress once streamed games on Twitch , such as Call of Duty, as well as single-player games like The Last of Us and Outlast, although it seems all videos have been pulled from the channel. A YouTube channel under her name also popped up earlier this month, uploading her past streams. It's unclear if the channel is actually owned by her or if someone else is just capitalizing on her old content, but nevertheless, you can still check out some of her old streams on the channel. Her partial playthrough of The Last of Us has racked up over 650,000 views in just three days, leading to a quippy response from PlayStation itself. "We're obsessed," said PlayStation UK's X account . In a recent interview with GQ , Navarrette talked about how she grew up with video games and eventually started streaming during her downtime. "It’s just something that I really love to do," she said. "One of my first games growing up that we would play, me and my older brother Amani, it’s the only thing we had to do at my Dad’s house. We started on the PS2, and we would play Shrek games in Big Head mode with my mom. And then I would branch off by myself to play campaign games. Me and Amani would play Call of Duty. He was really into Halo. Then we got into Red Dead and like, Fallout, like all of these games. "I just would play or watch my older brother. And then I built my own PC during COVID and that was really fun to start to get into PC games. It really just took off with me loving watching YouTubers growing up, like Markiplier. So for me, it was like, oh, why not? If I'm not working on a show and I love playing video games by myself and I love playing with friends, then why not stream? It became a lot of fun." It doesn't seem like Navarrette is active on Twitch these days, which isn't much of a surprise given that she is likely quite busy after the success of Obsession. The actress had previously played supporting roles in shows like 13 Reasons Why and Superman & Lois, but Obsession will likely take her to an all-new level. Whether she will have time to stream again remains to be seen, but at least there's a surplus of older content for fans to dig into. Cade Onder i
